# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old (in volume 1); deceased by volume 1's end  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed was an unusual-looking man with an awkward frame, hunching shoulders, and lengthy hair that turned silver before his death. He wore a thick, gentle brown beard on his face continuously from the age of twenty. In fine circumstances outside Brierley, he wore a white collar alongside his finest suit of clothes.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Extremely timid, bashful, and quiet, Obed disliked conversing or being surrounded by unfamiliar people. He possessed a severe dread of women, suspecting they quietly mocked him, though he liked loquacious companions who handled conversations on their own. He was tender-hearted, empathetic, and deeply sensitive, suffering internal distress when forced to harm harmless creatures or break bad news. He enjoyed silent reflection with his pipe and felt immense quiet pride in the achievements of those he loved.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c25 P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002), [v1 c32 P46](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0046)_

## History

Obed Abernethy resided at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister Thirza. Facing advancing age, heart trouble, and labor shortages, he and Thirza arranged to adopt a young orphan boy to help on the farm. Traveling to Alder River to meet the train, Obed discovered a misunderstanding had resulted in the arrival of a red-haired girl, Nell Harcourt. Unable to tell her directly that she was unexpected, he brought her home and supported keeping her despite Thirza's initial objections. Over time, Obed grew deeply fond of Nell, forming a strong bond with her and spoiling her with gifts, such as a stylish dress for Christmas bought with the help of Agatha Sowerby. He took immense pride in Nell's academic achievements, including her topping the pass list and winning the Avery scholarship. Upon learning of financial instability involving his family's savings bank, his anxiety mounted alongside his failing heart. Shortly after Nell won her scholarship, Obed collapsed at his doorway from a heart episode and passed away, being buried in the Brierley cemetery.
